sections.content:
Step 1: Double Click on the patient record for Captain Archer. You should see the following screen:

Step 2: Select Allergies on the left hand pane.

Step 3: Click the blue + button to add an episode

Step 4: In the below pane, click the orange icon next to "New episode" and switch it to red. Add a description "Allergic Reaction to Peanuts".

Step 5: Click Save and then OK to close the confirmation popup

 

Check: Have you succuesfully added an allergic reaction and changed the risk to high (red icon)?
sections.title: Adding Allergies

checkpoint.hint: Make sure you are still on the Allergies Page and have changed the orange icon to red.

sections.checkpointHint: Make sure you are still on the Allergies Page and have changed the orange icon to red.

sections.content:
We now need to add a new prescription for Captain Archer to help manage his peanut allergy. 

 

Step 1: Navigate to "Drug Prescriptions" on the left hand pane.

Step 2: Click the blue + button like you did in the previous section.

Step 3: Switch the orange icon to yellow (low) this time. 

Step 4: In the box that says "search by commercial name", search for Xolair and select the 2nd item in the list.

Step 5: Leave all the default options in the popup box and click "prescribe only".

 

Check: Have you succuesfully added a Xolair prescription for Captain Archer?
